annotations.text:
Three identities for auralab.sh — same content, three voices. Pick one (or mix) and I port it onto the live build.

A · Halo — the aura as light. Dark green-black, phosphor mint, Instrument Serif. Memorable, cinematic; reading-heavy inner pages would switch to light paper. Risk: a few senior peers read dark sites as 'startup'.

B · Field Notes — the lab notebook. Dot-grid paper, Bricolage Grotesque, highlighter marks, real figures and a ledger. Says 'we measure things' loudest. Risk: busiest of the three; must stay disciplined.

C · Monograph — the lab as a journal. Stone paper, Newsreader + small caps, gold foil rules, footnoted claims. Most peer-credible and timeless. Risk: quietest; students may find it formal.
